title: Polynomial-size circuit family
statement: A family of directed acyclic circuits has polynomial size if there are natural numbers $a$ and $k$ such that, for every input size $n$, the circuit has at most $a(n+1)^k$ gates.
hypotheses_covered: The size bound holds for every natural-number input size $n$
